events.text: Goal! Manchester City 1, AEK Athens 0. Elliot Anderson (Manchester City) left footed shot from very close range to the high centre of the goal following a set piece situation.
Goal! Manchester City 2, AEK Athens 0. Phil Foden (Manchester City) right footed shot from the right side of the six yard box to the top right corner. Assisted by Rico Lewis.
First Half ends, Manchester City 2, AEK Athens 0.
Substitution, AEK Athens. Aboubakary Koïta replaces Razvan Marin.
Substitution, AEK Athens. Zine replaces Barnabás Varga.
Second Half begins Manchester City 2, AEK Athens 0.
Goal! Manchester City 2, AEK Athens 1. Stavros Pilios (AEK Athens) left footed shot from the left side of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Zine following a fast break.
Goal! Manchester City 3, AEK Athens 1. Rayan Cherki (Manchester City) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Phil Foden.
Josko Gvardiol (Manchester City) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Delay in match because of an injury Lovro Majer (AEK Athens).
Delay in match because of an injury Josko Gvardiol (Manchester City).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Manchester City. Ryan McAidoo replaces Floyd Samba.
Substitution, AEK Athens. Oleksandr Zubkov replaces João Mário.
Goal! Manchester City 4, AEK Athens 1. Phil Foden (Manchester City) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the top left corner. Assisted by Rico Lewis.
Substitution, Manchester City. Vitor Reis replaces Josko Gvardiol.
Substitution, Manchester City. Rayan Aït-Nouri replaces Enzo Fernández.
Goal! Manchester City 5, AEK Athens 1. Phil Foden (Manchester City) left footed shot from very close range to the top left corner. Assisted by Ryan McAidoo.
Substitution, Manchester City. Kaden Braithwaite replaces Rúben Dias.
Substitution, AEK Athens. Mijat Gacinovic replaces Kervin Arriaga.
Substitution, AEK Athens. Milán Vitális replaces Luka Jovic.
Second Half ends, Manchester City 5, AEK Athens 1.
